content:
lee-newhire: hey folks, trying to finish onboarding but Okta rejects my sign-in with 'no MFA method registered'. the 1Password invite sits in my personal email but i need SSO to complete it. anyone know the quickest unblock?

devex_anya: welcome! :wave: you can register an authenticator app (Authy/Google Authenticator) or a hardware key. do you have a phone to set up TOTP?

lee-newhire: i do, but the Okta flow doesn't show the 'Set up authenticator' option — only 'Security Key (FIDO)' and 'Passkey'.

it_ops_mike: that means your team policy enforces passwordless keys. short-term we can grant a 12-hour exception so you can enroll TOTP and finish 1Password. ping @peopleops_nina to confirm shipping if you want a YubiKey long term.

peopleops_nina: we can ship a YubiKey but need the preferred delivery address. if you want the exception, confirm and we'll kick it off.

lee-newhire: yes please do the 12-hour exception. i'll use my phone's TOTP and then register the YubiKey when it arrives. address is the home address in the offer.

it_bot: Ticket #IT-4733 created: "Okta MFA policy blocks new hire lee-newhire; request 12h exception". Assigned to it_ops_mike.

it_ops_mike: granted 12-hour exception. you should now see authenticator app option in the Okta setup flow. once enrolled, you can accept the 1Password invite.

lee-newhire: enrolled TOTP, finished 1Password, and can access team drive. thanks all! also confirmed peopleops shipping YubiKey.

it_bot: #IT-4733 resolved. reopen ticket if access lapses.

devex_anya: when YubiKey arrives, add it in Okta -> Security Methods -> Add Security Key. ping me if you want help migrating from TOTP to passkey.
